name: code-snippet-dark-modern-vertical
title: VS Code Dark Modern (vertical)
description: Vertical VS Code editor in the Dark Modern theme: the file types character by character in the 780 field (lines up to 38 characters), the terminal rises; full with a Bebas title, or the window alone as a top / bottom card.
